name: zephyr-ide
description: Streamline Zephyr RTOS development in VS Code — automated SDK installation, west workspace management, project building, flashing, and debugging for ARM, RISC-V, and more

zephyr-ide.activeProjectPanel.showBuildD.description: Show the 'Build Dashboard' button at the bottom of the Active Project panel. When shown, the Kconfig button is hidden from the Build and Build Pristine rows (accessible via the dashboard instead).

zephyr-ide.buildBeforeFlash.description: Automatically build before flashing when using the 'Zephyr IDE: Flash' command. The dedicated 'Build and Flash' command always builds first regardless of this setting.

zephyr-ide.globalDirectory.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: Use 'zephyr-ide.toolchainDirectory' instead. The toolchain directory defaults to ~/.zephyr_ide/toolchains. Migrated automatically on startup.

zephyr-ide.toolchainDirectory.description: Manually specify the directory containing Zephyr SDK installations (e.g., containing zephyr-sdk-0.17.0, zephyr-sdk-0.17.3 subdirectories). If not specified, defaults to toolchains subdirectory within the tools directory.

enumDescriptions: Open the build dashboard to the main summary page (default).
Open the build dashboard and navigate directly to the Kconfig page.
Run 'west build -t guiconfig' to open the graphical Kconfig editor in a terminal.
Run 'west build -t menuconfig' to open the terminal-based Kconfig editor.
zephyr-ide.activeViewKconfigButton.description: Controls what the Kconfig button in the Active Project view does. Defaults to opening the main summary page of the build dashboard. Can also be set to open the Kconfig page of the dashboard, or to launch the external guiconfig or menuconfig tool.

enumDescriptions: Open the build dashboard and navigate directly to the Kconfig page (default).
Run 'west build -t guiconfig' to open the graphical Kconfig editor in a terminal.
Run 'west build -t menuconfig' to open the terminal-based Kconfig editor.
zephyr-ide.projectViewKconfigButton.description: Controls what the Config button in the Projects view does for a build. Defaults to opening the Kconfig page in the build dashboard. Can be changed to launch the external guiconfig or menuconfig tool instead.

zephyr-ide.westNarrowUpdate.description: Use 'west update --narrow' to reduce disk usage and download time by fetching only required Git history.

zephyr-ide.westKeepDescendants.description: Use 'west update --keep-descendants' to preserve local commits on top of the manifest revision. When enabled, west will not reset a project if its current HEAD is a descendant of the manifest revision.

zephyr-ide.westZephyrExport.description: Run 'west zephyr-export' after a successful west update. This registers the Zephyr CMake package so that out-of-tree applications can find Zephyr with 'find_package(Zephyr)'.

zephyr-ide.suppressWorkspaceWarning.description: Hide the notification about missing ZEPHYR_BASE and ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR environment variables. Enable this if you manage these variables externally.

zephyr-ide.venvFolder.description: Manually specify a Python virtual environment folder path. If not specified, defaults to .venv in the workspace setup path.

zephyr-ide.disableZephyrBaseInjection.description: Disable Zephyr IDE's automatic injection of the ZEPHYR_BASE environment variable into terminals, tasks, and build/debug processes. Enable this if you manage ZEPHYR_BASE yourself.

zephyr-ide.zephyrBaseOverride.description: Absolute or workspace-root-relative path to a Zephyr base directory. When set, this overrides the ZEPHYR_BASE value Zephyr IDE would otherwise inject. Ignored when 'zephyr-ide.disableZephyrBaseInjection' is true.

zephyr-ide.automaticProjectSelection.description: Automatically switch the active project when the editor focus changes to a file belonging to a different project.

zephyr-ide.separateBuildDebugProfile.description: Expose a separate 'Build & Debug' bind slot in Runner Profiles. When enabled, 'Build and Debug' and 'Debug' can each have an independent runner or launch configuration binding. When disabled (default), the single 'Debug' slot drives both actions.

zephyr-ide.useClangd.description: Use clangd for IntelliSense instead of the C/C++ extension. When enabled, sets 'C_Cpp.intelliSenseEngine' to 'disabled' and configures 'clangd.arguments' with the compile-commands directory and Zephyr SDK query-driver. Workspace settings are applied automatically when this setting changes. Requires the clangd VS Code extension (llvm-vs-code-extensions.vscode-clangd).

enumDescriptions: Use dtdoctor (Zephyr's built-in devicetree SCA tool, bundled in the Zephyr repo — no extra install needed).
Use GCC -fanalyzer (requires GCC 12+, already in the Zephyr SDK — no extra install needed).
Use Clang static analyzer (requires Clang to be installed).
Use Sparse (lightweight C semantic parser, requires sparse to be installed).
Use CodeChecker (open-source analysis framework, requires CodeChecker to be installed).
Use Coverity (commercial static analysis tool, requires Coverity installation and license).
Use Parasoft C/C++test (commercial, requires cpptest installation and license).
Use ECLAIR (commercial static analysis tool, requires ECLAIR installation and license).
Use IAR C-STAT (requires IAR toolchain and license).
Use Polyspace (commercial, requires MathWorks Polyspace installation and license).
Use the custom variant specified in 'zephyr-ide.scaCustomVariant'.
Disable SCA. No ZEPHYR_SCA_VARIANT is passed to CMake.
zephyr-ide.scaVariant.description: Static Code Analysis (SCA) tool to enable on pristine builds via -DZEPHYR_SCA_VARIANT. Defaults to none (disabled). Set to 'dtdoctor' for Zephyr's built-in DT diagnostic tool.

zephyr-ide.scaCustomVariant.description: Custom SCA variant name passed as -DZEPHYR_SCA_VARIANT when 'zephyr-ide.scaVariant' is set to 'custom'. Must match a cmake/sca/<name>/sca.cmake entry in the Zephyr tree.

zephyr-ide.projectVariableDefaults.description: Default project variable names to show in the Project Details panel. Missing values are shown as empty.

zephyr-ide.buildVariableDefaults.description: Default build variable names to show in the Project Details panel. Missing values are shown as empty.

zephyr-ide.runnerProfiles.markdownDescription: Reusable runner profiles (name + per-slot binds for `flash`, `debug`, `attach`). Each slot bind selects `auto`, a zephyr `runner` with optional extra args, or a named VS Code `launch` configuration. Workspace `.vscode/zephyr-ide.json` `runnerProfiles` overrides this on name collision.

[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
[Clone Repository](command:git.clone)
To learn more about how to use git and source control in VS Code [read our docs](https://aka.ms/vscode-scm).

servertype.description: cortex-debug server type. Preferred over `runner` for native debuggers; Zephyr IDE reads the matching runner's args from runners.yaml automatically. For bridged targets (nrfjprog, linkserver, esp32, stm32cubeprogrammer, …) use the Zephyr IDE West debugger instead.

runner.description: Optional Zephyr runner to use. Prefer `servertype` for native cortex-debug servers (jlink, openocd, pyocd, stlink, bmp, qemu). `runner` is mainly for bridged targets driven via `west debugserver` (cortex-debug servertype "external"): nrfjprog, linkserver, esp32, stm32cubeprogrammer. When both are omitted, the runner is read from runners.yaml's debug-runner.

project.description: Pin this debug configuration to a specific Zephyr IDE project name. When omitted, the active project is used. If `build` is also omitted, the project's active build is used.

build.description: Pin this debug configuration to a specific build configuration name within the project. When omitted, the project's active build is used.

enumDescriptions: Use the active project and active build silently (default).
Prompt for both project and build at every launch.
Prompt for project at launch; use that project's active build.
Use the active project; prompt for which build to debug.
ask.description: Controls whether Zephyr IDE asks the user to pick a project and/or build at session start. Ignored when `project` or `build` are explicitly set.

svdFile.description: Optional path to an SVD file for the cortex-debug peripheral viewer. When omitted, Zephyr IDE searches the board directory for a .svd file.

executable.description: Override the ELF file to debug. When omitted, Zephyr IDE uses elf_file from runners.yaml.

gdbPath.description: Override the GDB executable. When omitted, Zephyr IDE uses the gdb path from runners.yaml.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debug session. Defaults to the workspace folder.

BMPGDBSerialPort.description: Black Magic Probe GDB serial port (e.g. "/dev/ttyACM0" on Linux/macOS, "COM3" on Windows, or "${config:bmp_serial_port}"). Required when using marus25.cortex-debug; optional when using mylonics.bmp-debug (auto-discovers the probe).

device.description: Target device identifier (e.g. "STM32F401RE", "nRF52840_xxAA"). Forwarded to cortex-debug.

configFiles.description: OpenOCD .cfg files. Auto-derived from runners.yaml's --openocd-config / --cmd-pre-init args; supply here to override.

searchDir.description: OpenOCD search directories (--openocd-search). Auto-derived from runners.yaml; supply here to extend.

serverpath.description: Path to the GDB server executable (openocd, JLinkGDBServerCL, pyocd, …). When omitted, cortex-debug looks on PATH; Zephyr IDE auto-fills runners.yaml's openocd path and the venv pyocd when available.

serverArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the GDB server's command line. Zephyr IDE forwards unrecognised pyocd/jlink args here automatically; use this field to add more.

gdbTarget.description: host:port the GDB client connects to. Only meaningful for servertype "external". When set, Zephyr IDE skips spawning `west debugserver` for bridged runners and uses your value directly.

targetId.description: pyocd target (--target). Auto-derived from runners.yaml's --target / -t for pyocd.

speed.description: J-Link debug interface speed in kHz. Forwarded to cortex-debug.

ipAddress.description: J-Link / cortex-debug remote server IP address.

port.description: GDB server port. Cortex-debug uses this when servertype is "external" without a gdbTarget host.

rttConfig.description: RTT decoder configuration. Auto-populated by Zephyr IDE when `--enable-rtt` is set on the runner's extraArgs; override here for custom decoders.

swoConfig.description: SWO/SWV configuration object passed to cortex-debug.

runToEntryPoint.description: Run to this symbol on launch (e.g. "main").

breakAfterReset.description: Break after reset instead of running to entry.

preLaunchCommands.description: GDB commands executed before the program is loaded.

postLaunchCommands.description: GDB commands executed after the program is loaded but before it runs.

postRestartCommands.description: Alias of postResetCommands honoured by cortex-debug.

overrideLaunchCommands.description: If set, REPLACES the standard cortex-debug launch sequence (file/load/break/run).

overrideAttachCommands.description: If set, REPLACES the standard cortex-debug attach sequence.

overrideResetCommands.description: If set, REPLACES the standard cortex-debug reset sequence.

overrideRestartCommands.description: If set, REPLACES the standard cortex-debug restart sequence.

liveWatch.description: Live-watch configuration object passed to cortex-debug.

objdumpPath.description: Path to objdump for the disassembly view. Defaults to gdb's sibling tool.

nmPath.description: Path to nm for the global-symbol view. Defaults to gdb's sibling tool.

servertype.description: cortex-debug server type. Preferred over `runner` for native debuggers. See `launch.servertype`.

runner.description: Optional Zephyr runner. Prefer `servertype` for native cortex-debug servers. See `launch.runner` for the full list.

project.description: Pin this debug configuration to a specific Zephyr IDE project name. When omitted, the active project is used.

build.description: Pin this debug configuration to a specific build configuration name. When omitted, the project's active build is used.

enumDescriptions: Use the active project and active build silently (default).
Prompt for both project and build at every launch.
Prompt for project at launch; use that project's active build.
Use the active project; prompt for which build to debug.
ask.description: Controls whether Zephyr IDE asks the user to pick a project and/or build at session start. Ignored when `project` or `build` are explicitly set.

svdFile.description: Optional path to an SVD file for the cortex-debug peripheral viewer. When omitted, Zephyr IDE searches the board directory for a .svd file.

executable.description: Override the ELF file. When omitted, Zephyr IDE uses elf_file from runners.yaml.

gdbPath.description: Override the GDB executable. When omitted, Zephyr IDE uses the gdb path from runners.yaml.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debug session. Defaults to the workspace folder.

BMPGDBSerialPort.description: Black Magic Probe GDB serial port. See `launch.BMPGDBSerialPort`.

device.description: Target device identifier. Forwarded to cortex-debug.

serverpath.description: Path to the GDB server executable.

serverArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the GDB server's command line.

overrideAttachCommands.description: If set, REPLACES the standard cortex-debug attach sequence.

overrideResetCommands.description: If set, REPLACES the standard cortex-debug reset sequence.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug
configurationSnippets.description: Debug the active build using runners.yaml (no runner-specific config required).

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Attach
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to the active build using runners.yaml.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (ask build at launch)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug the active project but prompt the user to select a build configuration each time F5 is pressed. Change ask to "askBoth" to prompt for project as well.

body.name: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (ask build at launch)

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (J-Link)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug using J-Link. Zephyr IDE reads --device, --speed, and --iface from runners.yaml and translates them to cortex-debug fields automatically.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (pyOCD)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug using pyOCD. Zephyr IDE reads --target and --probe from runners.yaml and translates them to cortex-debug fields. Uses the workspace venv pyocd when available.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (pyOCD with ST-Link probe)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug using pyOCD with an ST-Link probe explicitly selected. pyOCD matches --probe as a substring against the probe description, so "stlink" selects any connected ST-Link. Other runners.yaml args (--target, etc.) are still applied automatically.

body.name: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (pyOCD with ST-Link probe)

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (ST-Link)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug using ST-Link. Zephyr IDE reads --device from runners.yaml and passes it to cortex-debug servertype "stlink".

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (Black Magic Probe)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug using Black Magic Probe. Zephyr IDE reads --gdb-serial from runners.yaml and translates it to BMPGDBSerialPort. Add a BMPGDBSerialPort field here to override. Install mylonics.bmp-debug for Zephyr RTOS thread awareness — it auto-discovers the probe so BMPGDBSerialPort is not required.

body.name: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (Black Magic Probe)

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Attach (Black Magic Probe)
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to a running target via Black Magic Probe. Zephyr IDE reads --gdb-serial from runners.yaml. Add a BMPGDBSerialPort field here to override if runners.yaml does not include --gdb-serial.

body.name: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Attach (Black Magic Probe)

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug Sysbuild Image
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a sysbuild domain. Identical to "Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug" — the active sysbuild image (selected in the Project Build panel) determines which domain's runners.yaml is used. No per-domain field is written into launch.json; switch the active image to switch domains.

body.name: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug Sysbuild Image

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (openocd with explicit probe)
configurationSnippets.description: Override runners.yaml's interface config to use a specific probe (e.g. switch from the board-default J-Link to an ST-Link). Supplying an interface/ cfg file automatically filters out the interface/ entry from runners.yaml so the two do not conflict.

body.name: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (openocd with explicit probe)

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex: Debug (fully manual)
configurationSnippets.description: Manually specify all debug server settings while letting Zephyr IDE auto-fill the ELF, GDB path, and project context from runners.yaml. Use when the auto-translation does not produce the cortex-debug config you need. `servertype` overrides the runner-derived value; `configFiles`/`searchDir`/`rttConfig` override any runners.yaml args.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE Cortex (Legacy): Manual debug configuration
configurationSnippets.description: Advanced: write a cortex-debug configuration directly using Zephyr IDE helper commands. Prefer the `zephyr-ide` type above — it reads runners.yaml automatically. Use this only when you need features not exposed by the zephyr-ide provider.

runner.description: Zephyr runner used by west debugserver (for example: nrfjprog, linkserver, openocd).

port.description: [Common] GDB server / connection port (west debugserver flag: --port).

devId.description: [Common] Device/probe identifier to select a specific connected probe (west debugserver flag: --dev-id).

toolOpt.description: [Common] Extra options passed through to the underlying tool, repeated per value (west debugserver flag: --tool-opt).

domain.description: [Common] Sysbuild domain/image to debug (west debugserver flag: --domain).

elfFile.description: [Common] ELF file to debug (west debugserver flag: --elf-file).

hexFile.description: [Common] HEX file to load (west debugserver flag: --hex-file).

binFile.description: [Common] BIN file to load (west debugserver flag: --bin-file).

gdbPort.description: [Common] Port the GDB server listens on (west debugserver flag: --gdb-port).

tclPort.description: [Common] Port for the server's TCL/RPC interface (west debugserver flag: --tcl-port).

telnetPort.description: [Common] Port for the server's telnet interface (west debugserver flag: --telnet-port).

noLoad.description: [Common] Do not load the image before debugging (west debugserver flag: --no-load).

noReset.description: [Common] Do not reset the target (west debugserver flag: --no-reset).

rebuild.description: [Common] Rebuild the application before debugging; mutually exclusive with noRebuild (west debugserver flag: --rebuild).

noRebuild.description: [Common] Skip rebuilding the application before debugging (west debugserver flag: --no-rebuild).

westExtraServerArgs.description: [Common] Additional curated server args appended before the westArgs passthrough.

serial.description: [Common] Probe serial number, e.g. an FTDI serial (west debugserver flag: --serial).

interface.description: [Common] Debug interface, e.g. swd or jtag (west debugserver flag: --iface).

connectUnderReset.description: [Common] Connect to the target while holding reset asserted (west debugserver flag: --connect-under-reset).

erase.description: [Common] Mass-erase the target before loading (west debugserver flag: --erase).

noErase.description: [Common] Do not erase the target before loading (west debugserver flag: --no-erase).

reset.description: [Common] Reset the target after flashing (west debugserver flag: --reset).

tui.description: [Common] Launch GDB with its text UI (west debugserver flag: --tui).

config.description: [openocd] OpenOCD config commands/files, repeated per value (west debugserver flag: --config).

flashAddress.description: [openocd] Flash address used for BIN files (west debugserver flag: --flash-address).

noHalt.description: [openocd] Omit the halt command from the GDB server startup (west debugserver flag: --no-halt).

noInit.description: [openocd] Omit the init command from the GDB server startup (west debugserver flag: --no-init).

noTargets.description: [openocd] Omit the target command from the GDB server startup (west debugserver flag: --no-targets).

targetHandle.description: [openocd] Internal OpenOCD target handle (west debugserver flag: --target-handle).

rttPort.description: [openocd] Port for the OpenOCD RTT server (west debugserver flag: --rtt-port).

rttServer.description: [openocd] Start an RTT server while debugging (west debugserver flag: --rtt-server).

gdbClientPort.description: [openocd] Port the GDB client connects to (west debugserver flag: --gdb-client-port).

gdbInit.description: [openocd] GDB init commands, repeated per value (west debugserver flag: --gdb-init).

gdbHost.description: [probe-rs, jlink] Host the GDB server binds to (west debugserver flag: --gdb-host).

protocol.description: [probe-rs, jlink] Debug protocol, swd or jtag (west debugserver flag: --protocol).

speed.description: [probe-rs, jlink] Protocol speed in kHz (west debugserver flag: --speed).

batch.description: [jlink] Enable J-Link batch mode (west debugserver flag: --batch).

dtFlash.description: [jlink] Use devicetree flash address info (west debugserver flag: --dt-flash=y).

westArgs.description: Raw passthrough: additional west debugserver arguments for full CLI coverage (runner-specific options, --cmd-* flags, etc.). Appended after all curated options.

hexFile.description: [Common] HEX file to load (west debugserver flag: --hex-file).

binFile.description: [Common] BIN file to load (west debugserver flag: --bin-file).

gdbPort.description: [Common] Port the GDB server listens on (west debugserver flag: --gdb-port).

tclPort.description: [Common] Port for the server's TCL/RPC interface (west debugserver flag: --tcl-port).

telnetPort.description: [Common] Port for the server's telnet interface (west debugserver flag: --telnet-port).

noLoad.description: [Common] Do not load the image before debugging (west debugserver flag: --no-load).

noReset.description: [Common] Do not reset the target (west debugserver flag: --no-reset).

rebuild.description: [Common] Rebuild the application before debugging; mutually exclusive with noRebuild (west debugserver flag: --rebuild).

noRebuild.description: [Common] Skip rebuilding the application before debugging (west debugserver flag: --no-rebuild).

westExtraServerArgs.description: [Common] Additional curated server args appended before the westArgs passthrough.

serial.description: [Common] Probe serial number, e.g. an FTDI serial (west debugserver flag: --serial).

interface.description: [Common] Debug interface, e.g. swd or jtag (west debugserver flag: --iface).

connectUnderReset.description: [Common] Connect to the target while holding reset asserted (west debugserver flag: --connect-under-reset).

erase.description: [Common] Mass-erase the target before loading (west debugserver flag: --erase).

noErase.description: [Common] Do not erase the target before loading (west debugserver flag: --no-erase).

reset.description: [Common] Reset the target after flashing (west debugserver flag: --reset).

tui.description: [Common] Launch GDB with its text UI (west debugserver flag: --tui).

config.description: [openocd] OpenOCD config commands/files, repeated per value (west debugserver flag: --config).

flashAddress.description: [openocd] Flash address used for BIN files (west debugserver flag: --flash-address).

noHalt.description: [openocd] Omit the halt command from the GDB server startup (west debugserver flag: --no-halt).

noInit.description: [openocd] Omit the init command from the GDB server startup (west debugserver flag: --no-init).

noTargets.description: [openocd] Omit the target command from the GDB server startup (west debugserver flag: --no-targets).

targetHandle.description: [openocd] Internal OpenOCD target handle (west debugserver flag: --target-handle).

rttPort.description: [openocd] Port for the OpenOCD RTT server (west debugserver flag: --rtt-port).

rttServer.description: [openocd] Start an RTT server while debugging (west debugserver flag: --rtt-server).

gdbClientPort.description: [openocd] Port the GDB client connects to (west debugserver flag: --gdb-client-port).

gdbInit.description: [openocd] GDB init commands, repeated per value (west debugserver flag: --gdb-init).

gdbHost.description: [probe-rs, jlink] Host the GDB server binds to (west debugserver flag: --gdb-host).

protocol.description: [probe-rs, jlink] Debug protocol, swd or jtag (west debugserver flag: --protocol).

speed.description: [probe-rs, jlink] Protocol speed in kHz (west debugserver flag: --speed).

batch.description: [jlink] Enable J-Link batch mode (west debugserver flag: --batch).

dtFlash.description: [jlink] Use devicetree flash address info (west debugserver flag: --dt-flash=y).

westArgs.description: Raw passthrough: additional west debugserver arguments for full CLI coverage (runner-specific options, --cmd-* flags, etc.). Appended after all curated options.

svdFile.description: Optional path to an SVD file for peripheral viewer support.

gdbTarget.description: Optional host:port for an already running debugserver. When set, west debugserver is not spawned.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE West: Debug (any runner)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug through `west debugserver` with any runner. Zephyr IDE spawns `west debugserver --runner <runner>`, parses the listening port, and connects cortex-debug as servertype "external". ELF and GDB path are read from runners.yaml. Add curated west options or westArgs for runner-specific flags.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE West: Debug (OpenOCD)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug via OpenOCD through the west debugserver bridge. Zephyr IDE spawns `west debugserver --runner openocd` and connects cortex-debug as servertype "external". Use the [openocd] curated options (config, rttServer, …) or westArgs for extra flags.

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE West: Debug (STM32CubeProgrammer)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug an STM32 target via STM32CubeProgrammer through the west debugserver bridge. Zephyr IDE spawns `west debugserver --runner stm32cubeprogrammer` and connects cortex-debug as servertype "external".

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE West: Debug (nrfjprog)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a Nordic nRF target via the west debugserver bridge. Zephyr IDE spawns `west debugserver --runner nrfjprog`, reads the listening GDB port from its stdout, and connects cortex-debug as servertype "external".

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE West: Debug (linkserver)
configurationSnippets.description: Debug an NXP target via LinkServer through the west debugserver bridge. Zephyr IDE spawns `west debugserver --runner linkserver`, parses the listening port, and connects cortex-debug as servertype "external".

configurationSnippets.label: Zephyr IDE West: Attach to external GDB server
configurationSnippets.description: Connect to an already-running GDB server at a fixed address (Segger Ozone, vendor IDE, or a server you started manually). Setting `gdbTarget` suppresses the automatic west debugserver spawn; the `runner` value is only used to look up the ELF and GDB path from runners.yaml.
